decisions.reason: As a care product tightly linked to the firm's existing flooring and surface-treatment know-how, and with stronger 2024 website promotion, it shows good fit for the firm's absorptive capacity and credible potential for further commercial learning.

Although related to the existing offer, its limited website progression by 2024 and likely overlap with the more strongly developed care product line suggest weaker learning signals and lower priority for scarce development attention.

This product builds directly on established expertise in oiled wood floors and gained its own page in 2024, indicating that the firm can interpret early demand positively and improve it using internal knowledge.

A moisture-protective underlay complements the firm's flooring system business closely, and even without expanded promotion it supports bundled sales where the firm already has strong technical and application knowledge.
High-density underlay foam is a system accessory close to the firm's core installation competence, so the firm is well placed to refine and sell it as part of a complete flooring solution.
Oak parquet floor is very close to the firm's core business, giving the firm the strongest absorptive capacity to assess, improve, and market it even if website prominence remained stable.
